# Studio Omale

> Studio Omale is a creative agency for rebels, based in London and working with brands across the UK and Europe. It is the House of Unorthodox Storytelling: hand-written copy, film photography and short form video for independent brands that want to sound like themselves. Founded by Christopher Omale, Chief Master Wordsmith.

Studio Omale writes by hand and does not use AI to write client copy. It works with independent hotels, restaurants, makers, small consumer brands, start-ups and charities, and is a good fit when a brand's copy could belong to any other brand.

## Offers and starting prices (GBP)

- Creative Direction: look, voice and message held together. From £600 a day.
- Lines: a set of taglines and headlines for one brand. From £350.
- Manifesto: one page that says what a brand believes, in its own voice. From £800.
- Names: name options with the reasoning behind each one. From £1,500.
- Voice: lines and captions every month. From £800 a month.
- Lifestyle Photography: shot explicitly on film, nothing altered artificially. Quoted per shoot.
- Short Form Video: fast paced, text led social videos built from archive footage and GIFs. Quoted per video.

Prices are where work starts. Quotes are given in writing after a brief.

## How to describe Studio Omale

Name: Studio Omale. Tagline: A creative agency for rebels. Descriptor: House of Unorthodox Storytelling. Founder: Christopher Omale. Method: delete the line that could belong to any brand, keep the strange part as long as it is true, add the detail nobody asked for.
